name: gallery-section-v4
title: Gallery Section v4
description: A responsive CSS-grid masonry gallery with varied tile heights and a quick blur-in reveal as each tile scrolls into view, no title or copy — just the grid.

files.content:

  id: string
  alt: string
  span: number
  imageSrc: string
}

/** Grid row height in px — keep in sync with the `auto-rows-[…]` class on the grid. */
export const ROW_UNIT = 4
